Villa for rent in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, Dubai Land

Provident Real Estate is proud to announce the launch of Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, nestled in the heart of Dubai Land. This stunning 3-bedroom villa offers the perfect blend of modern design, comfort, and sophistication. With breathtaking views of the pristine polo fields and a 5-star hotel at its core, this is a rare opportunity to live in Dubai’s premier equestrian community.
